subject.title: fix(skill-workshop): validate apply body and show change summary before destructive writes

question: Should suspicious low-overlap Skill Workshop replacements force pending approval even when the configured or default lifecycle policy is automatic?
rationale: The change is a strong data-loss safeguard, but it deliberately creates an exception to a recently merged user-facing approval policy; repository history cannot determine whether that workflow tradeoff is intended.

options.title: Keep the safety exception
options.body: Require explicit approval only for suspicious destructive replacements while ordinary lifecycle actions continue using automatic approval.

options.title: Preserve unconditional automatic approval
options.body: Retain the existing policy and redesign protection around stronger rejection, preview, or recovery behavior without introducing a pending-approval exception.

recommendation.title: Keep the safety exception
recommendation.body: Require explicit approval only for suspicious destructive replacements while ordinary lifecycle actions continue using automatic approval.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current automatic-approval behavior that this PR conditionally overrides.
